selection: Tree count and candidate variant selected on 2021; 2022 specialist uses frozen 2021 tree count and no early stopping. Other cached components retain their original selection histories.
uncertainty: Conditional paired circular moving-block bootstrap over consecutive daily case starts, preserving all 2352 outputs per sampled case. 120 draws per block length, seed 4173. Percentile intervals do not correct for repeated experimentation or model selection; positive draw fractions are not p-values or probabilities of future improvement.
validation_caveat: Both 2021 and 2022 are heavily reused development years. Jan7+ removes 6 case starts whose prediction horizons overlap 2021 selection cases; it does not create an independent holdout. Competition labels are not used.
slice_note: Subset AUC describes ranking within a slice, not its contribution to overall micro AUC. Incident metrics count misordered positive-negative pairs touching a slice, adjusted for the availability of such pairs. Shares overlap across slices. Negative incident_error_delta_in_global_pair_units is beneficial.

transition_regions.definition: Within +/-2 hours of true-label state change, first new-state hour as center; diagnostic only.

economic_boundary.definition: abs((price - local terminal water value)/max(mean(abs(weekly prices)),10)) < 0.1; proxy, not exact optimizer opportunity cost.

changed_pair_decomposition.note: Only target probabilities changed. These two disjoint categories sum to minus the overall AUC delta; unlike incident shares they are additive.

conclusion.promotion: More promising than the Lio replacement: the preselected Haukeli mean is essentially tied in 2021 and improves frozen-count 2022 confirmation. A reasonable candidate to retain for final combined validation, without claiming independent confirmation.
conclusion.2021: Pooled AUC +0.000004950. All three conditional intervals span zero; 6 of 12 within-month AUCs improve. This was the selection year.
conclusion.2022: Pooled AUC +0.000187878; Jan7+ +0.000188779. All three conditional block intervals remain positive in both views. 8 of 12 within-month AUCs improve, while incident pair errors decline in 11 of 12 month slices; November regresses.
conclusion.target: Final Haukeli AUC rises 0.947598300 to 0.958093875 in 2022. Incident error enrichment declines from 1.6468 to 1.5423 relative to pair availability. Other generator probabilities are unchanged.
conclusion.selection_discipline: Keep the 2021-selected candidate_mean and 121 trees. The larger 2022 full-replacement gain does not justify switching variants after seeing confirmation labels.
